2	 * AuctionLifecycle — closes ended auctions and runs a polling timer.
3	 *
4	 * Design decisions:
5	 *  - No bids → NoSale; notify seller; release all holds (CLAUDE.md #1)
6	 *  - Winner → Awarded; deduct deposit; notify all participants (CLAUDE.md #2)
7	 *  - Timer polls every 15 s; first tab to update status "wins" (idempotent guard)
8	 */
9	
10	import { db } from '@/db'
11	import { writeAuditLog } from '@/utils/audit'
12	import { generateId } from '@/crypto'
13	import { deductDeposit, releaseReservation } from './walletService'
14	import { broadcast } from './bidChannel'
15	import type { Auction } from '@/types'
16	
17	// ── closeAuction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
18	
19	export async function closeAuction(auction: Auction): Promise<void> {
20	  if (!['Active', 'Extended', 'Ended'].includes(auction.status)) return
21	
22	  const bids = await db.bids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
23	
24	  // ── No-bid scenario → NoSale ───────────────────────────────────────────────
25	  if (bids.length === 0) {
26	    await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'NoSale', updatedAt: Date.now() })
27	
28	    await writeAuditLog({
29	      eventType: 'auction.no_sale',
30	      actorId: 'system',
31	      actorName: 'System',
32	      entityType: 'Auction',
33	      entityId: auction.id,
34	      description: `Auction "${auction.title}" ended with no bids — marked No Sale`,
35	    })
36	
37	    await db.notifications.add({
38	      id: generateId(),
39	      userId: auction.createdBy,
40	      type: 'AuctionNoSale',
41	      title: 'Auction Ended — No Sale',
42	      message: `Your auction "${auction.title}" received no bids and has been marked as No Sale.`,
43	      isRead: false,
44	      relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
45	      relatedEntityId: auction.id,
46	      createdAt: Date.now(),
47	    })
48	
49	    broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
50	    return
51	  }
52	
53	  // ── Determine winner: highest amount; tie → earliest createdAt ─────────────
54	  const sorted = [...bids].sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount || a.createdAt - b.createdAt)
55	  const winning = sorted[0] as (typeof sorted)[number] | undefined
56	  if (!winning) return // guard — should not happen since bids.length > 0
57	
58	  const loserIds = [...new Set(bids.map((b) => b.bidderId))].filter(
59	    (id) => id !== winning.bidderId,
60	  )
61	
62	  // Update auction status and deactivate proxies — no crypto needed here.
63	  await db.transaction('rw', [db.auctions, db.proxyBids], async () => {
64	    await db.auctions.update(auction.id, {
65	      status: 'Awarded',
66	      winnerId: winning.bidderId,
67	      winningBidId: winning.id,
68	      updatedAt: Date.now(),
69	    })
70	
71	    const proxies = await db.proxyBids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
72	    await Promise.all(
73	      proxies.map((p) => db.proxyBids.update(p.id, { isActive: false, updatedAt: Date.now() })),
74	    )
75	  })
76	
77	  // Wallet operations use Web Crypto (encrypt/decrypt) and MUST run outside any
78	  // Dexie transaction to avoid PrematureCommitError (see walletService comments).
79	  await deductDeposit(winning.bidderId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)
80	  await Promise.all(
81	    loserIds.map((loserId) => releaseReservation(loserId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)),
82	  )
83	
84	  // Notifications and audit log — simple IndexedDB writes, no crypto.
85	  await db.notifications.add({
86	    id: generateId(),
87	    userId: winning.bidderId,
88	    type: 'AuctionWon',
89	    title: 'You Won the Auction!',
90	    message: `Congratulations! Your bid of ${String(winning.amount)} won "${auction.title}". A deposit of ${String(auction.depositAmount)} has been deducted from your wallet.`,
91	    isRead: false,
92	    relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
93	    relatedEntityId: auction.id,
94	    createdAt: Date.now(),
95	  })
96	
97	  await Promise.all(
98	    loserIds.map((loserId) =>
99	      db.notifications.add({
100	        id: generateId(),
101	        userId: loserId,
102	        type: 'BidOutbid',
103	        title: 'Auction Ended',
104	        message: `The auction "${auction.title}" has ended. Your deposit hold has been released.`,
105	        isRead: false,
106	        relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
107	        relatedEntityId: auction.id,
108	        createdAt: Date.now(),
109	      }),
110	    ),
111	  )
112	
113	  await writeAuditLog({
114	    eventType: 'auction.closed',
115	    actorId: 'system',
116	    actorName: 'System',
117	    entityType: 'Auction',
118	    entityId: auction.id,
119	    description: `Auction "${auction.title}" awarded to ${winning.bidderId} at ${String(winning.amount)}`,
120	  })
121	
122	  broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
123	}
124	
125	// ── Timer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
126	
127	let _timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null
128	
129	/**
130	 * Start a 15-second polling loop that closes any auctions whose endTime has passed.
131	 * Returns a cleanup function — call it in a React useEffect cleanup.
132	 */
133	export function startAuctionLifecycleTimer(): () => void {
134	  const tick = async () => {
135	    const now = Date.now()
136	    const toClose = await db.auctions
137	      .where('status')
138	      .anyOf('Active', 'Extended')
139	      .filter((a) => a.endTime <= now)
140	      .toArray()
141	
142	    for (const auction of toClose) {
143	      // Atomic guard: only process if we successfully transition to Ended
144	      const claimed = await db.transaction('rw', db.auctions, async () => {
145	        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
146	        if (!fresh || !['Active', 'Extended'].includes(fresh.status)) return false
147	        await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'Ended', updatedAt: Date.now() })
148	        return true
149	      })
150	
151	      if (claimed) {
152	        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
153	        if (fresh) await closeAuction(fresh)
154	      }
155	    }
156	  }
157	
158	  void tick()
159	  _timer = setInterval(() => {
160	    void tick()
161	  }, 15_000)
162	
163	  return () => {
164	    if (_timer !== null) {
165	      clearInterval(_timer)
166	      _timer = null
167	    }
168	  }
169	}

154	export type ConflictStrategy = 'skip' | 'overwrite'
155	
156	export interface ParsedBackup {
157	  exportedAt: string
158	  module: string
159	  data: Record<string, unknown[]>
160	}
161	
162	export interface ImportResult {
163	  table: string
164	  inserted: number
165	  skipped: number
166	  overwritten: number
167	}
168	
169	export function isValidBackup(parsed: unknown): parsed is ParsedBackup {
170	  if (typeof parsed !== 'object' || parsed === null) return false
171	  const obj = parsed as Record<string, unknown>
172	  if (typeof obj.exportedAt !== 'string') return false
173	  if (typeof obj.data !== 'object' || obj.data === null) return false
174	  const data = obj.data as Record<string, unknown>
175	  // At least one table must be present
176	  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) return false
177	  // Every value must be an array
178	  for (const val of Object.values(data)) {
179	    if (!Array.isArray(val)) return false
180	  }
181	  return true
182	}
183	
184	export async function runImport(
185	  backup: ParsedBackup,
186	  strategy: ConflictStrategy,
187	  actorId: string,
188	  actorName: string,
189	): Promise<ImportResult[]> {
190	  requirePermission('manageSystem')
191	
192	  const results: ImportResult[] = []
193	
194	  for (const tableName of IMPORTABLE_TABLES) {
195	    const rows = backup.data[tableName]
196	    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) continue
197	    if (SKIP_ALWAYS.has(tableName)) continue
198	
199	    const table = TABLE_MAP[tableName]
200	
201	    let inserted = 0
202	    let skipped = 0
203	    let overwritten = 0
204	
205	    for (const row of rows) {
206	      if (typeof row !== 'object' || row === null || !('id' in row)) continue
207	      const record = row as Record<string, unknown>
208	      const id = record.id as string
209	
210	      // User rows: only restore when the backup contains hashed credentials.
211	      // Rows without passwordHash/passwordSalt (e.g. from a module-only export)
212	      // are skipped — inserting credential-less accounts would make them
213	      // permanently non-operable (login requires a valid PBKDF2 hash).
214	      // Existing users are never overwritten to prevent credential clobbering.
215	      if (tableName === 'users') {
216	        const existing = await db.users.get(id)
217	        if (existing) { skipped++; continue }
218	        if (!record.passwordHash || !record.passwordSalt) { skipped++; continue }
219	        await db.users.add(record as Parameters<typeof db.users.add>[0])
220	        inserted++
221	        continue
222	      }
223	
224	      // auditLogs: append-only — add missing entries, never overwrite
225	      if (tableName === 'auditLogs') {
226	        const existing = await db.auditLogs.get(id)
227	        if (existing) { skipped++; continue }
228	        await db.auditLogs.add(record as Parameters<typeof db.auditLogs.add>[0])
229	        inserted++
230	        continue
231	      }
232	
233	      // NOTE: for 'documents' and 'documentVersions', rows in the backup file
234	      // are expected to be in the encrypted StoredDocument / StoredDocumentVersion
235	      // shape (ciphertext strings for title/body/metadata). DataExportPage uses
236	      // db.documents.toArray() / db.documentVersions.toArray() (raw IndexedDB
237	      // reads) rather than listDocuments() / listAllDocumentVersions() (which
238	      // decrypt before returning) to preserve this contract. Writing the rows
239	      // back here as-is is correct — decryption happens on read via
240	      // getDocumentById() → decryptDocument().
241	      const existing = await table.get(id)
242	      if (existing) {
243	        if (strategy === 'skip') {
244	          skipped++
245	        } else {
246	          await table.put(record as ImportableRow)
247	          overwritten++
248	        }
249	      } else {
250	        await table.add(record as ImportableRow)
251	        inserted++
252	      }
253	    }
254	
255	    results.push({ table: tableName, inserted, skipped, overwritten })
256	  }
257	
258	  const totalInserted = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.inserted, 0)
259	  const totalOverwritten = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.overwritten, 0)
260	
261	  await writeAuditLog({
262	    eventType: 'system.data_imported',
263	    actorId,
264	    actorName,
265	    entityType: 'System',
266	    entityId: 'backup',
267	    description: `Data backup imported: ${totalInserted} records inserted, ${totalOverwritten} overwritten (strategy: ${strategy})`,
268	    metadata: {
269	      exportedAt: backup.exportedAt,
270	      module: backup.module,
271	      conflictStrategy: strategy,
272	      tableResults: results,
273	    },
274	  })
275	
276	  return results
277	}

1	/**
2	 * AuctionLifecycle — closes ended auctions and runs a polling timer.
3	 *
4	 * Design decisions:
5	 *  - No bids → NoSale; notify seller; release all holds (CLAUDE.md #1)
6	 *  - Winner → Awarded; deduct deposit; notify all participants (CLAUDE.md #2)
7	 *  - Timer polls every 15 s; first tab to update status "wins" (idempotent guard)
8	 */
9	
10	import { db } from '@/db'
11	import { writeAuditLog } from '@/utils/audit'
12	import { generateId } from '@/crypto'
13	import { deductDeposit, releaseReservation } from './walletService'
14	import { broadcast } from './bidChannel'
15	import type { Auction } from '@/types'
16	
17	// ── closeAuction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
18	
19	export async function closeAuction(auction: Auction): Promise<void> {
20	  if (!['Active', 'Extended', 'Ended'].includes(auction.status)) return
21	
22	  const bids = await db.bids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
23	
24	  // ── No-bid scenario → NoSale ───────────────────────────────────────────────
25	  if (bids.length === 0) {
26	    await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'NoSale', updatedAt: Date.now() })
27	
28	    await writeAuditLog({
29	      eventType: 'auction.no_sale',
30	      actorId: 'system',
31	      actorName: 'System',
32	      entityType: 'Auction',
33	      entityId: auction.id,
34	      description: `Auction "${auction.title}" ended with no bids — marked No Sale`,
35	    })
36	
37	    await db.notifications.add({
38	      id: generateId(),
39	      userId: auction.createdBy,
40	      type: 'AuctionNoSale',
41	      title: 'Auction Ended — No Sale',
42	      message: `Your auction "${auction.title}" received no bids and has been marked as No Sale.`,
43	      isRead: false,
44	      relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
45	      relatedEntityId: auction.id,
46	      createdAt: Date.now(),
47	    })
48	
49	    broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
50	    return
51	  }
52	
53	  // ── Determine winner: highest amount; tie → earliest createdAt ─────────────
54	  const sorted = [...bids].sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount || a.createdAt - b.createdAt)
55	  const winning = sorted[0] as (typeof sorted)[number] | undefined
56	  if (!winning) return // guard — should not happen since bids.length > 0
57	
58	  const loserIds = [...new Set(bids.map((b) => b.bidderId))].filter(
59	    (id) => id !== winning.bidderId,
60	  )
61	
62	  // Update auction status and deactivate proxies — no crypto needed here.
63	  await db.transaction('rw', [db.auctions, db.proxyBids], async () => {
64	    await db.auctions.update(auction.id, {
65	      status: 'Awarded',
66	      winnerId: winning.bidderId,
67	      winningBidId: winning.id,
68	      updatedAt: Date.now(),
69	    })
70	
71	    const proxies = await db.proxyBids.where('auctionId').equals(auction.id).toArray()
72	    await Promise.all(
73	      proxies.map((p) => db.proxyBids.update(p.id, { isActive: false, updatedAt: Date.now() })),
74	    )
75	  })
76	
77	  // Wallet operations use Web Crypto (encrypt/decrypt) and MUST run outside any
78	  // Dexie transaction to avoid PrematureCommitError (see walletService comments).
79	  await deductDeposit(winning.bidderId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)
80	  await Promise.all(
81	    loserIds.map((loserId) => releaseReservation(loserId, auction.id, auction.depositAmount)),
82	  )
83	
84	  // Notifications and audit log — simple IndexedDB writes, no crypto.
85	  await db.notifications.add({
86	    id: generateId(),
87	    userId: winning.bidderId,
88	    type: 'AuctionWon',
89	    title: 'You Won the Auction!',
90	    message: `Congratulations! Your bid of ${String(winning.amount)} won "${auction.title}". A deposit of ${String(auction.depositAmount)} has been deducted from your wallet.`,
91	    isRead: false,
92	    relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
93	    relatedEntityId: auction.id,
94	    createdAt: Date.now(),
95	  })
96	
97	  await Promise.all(
98	    loserIds.map((loserId) =>
99	      db.notifications.add({
100	        id: generateId(),
101	        userId: loserId,
102	        type: 'BidOutbid',
103	        title: 'Auction Ended',
104	        message: `The auction "${auction.title}" has ended. Your deposit hold has been released.`,
105	        isRead: false,
106	        relatedEntityType: 'Auction',
107	        relatedEntityId: auction.id,
108	        createdAt: Date.now(),
109	      }),
110	    ),
111	  )
112	
113	  await writeAuditLog({
114	    eventType: 'auction.closed',
115	    actorId: 'system',
116	    actorName: 'System',
117	    entityType: 'Auction',
118	    entityId: auction.id,
119	    description: `Auction "${auction.title}" awarded to ${winning.bidderId} at ${String(winning.amount)}`,
120	  })
121	
122	  broadcast({ type: 'AUCTION_CLOSED', auctionId: auction.id })
123	}
124	
125	// ── Timer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
126	
127	let _timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null
128	
129	/**
130	 * Start a 15-second polling loop that closes any auctions whose endTime has passed.
131	 * Returns a cleanup function — call it in a React useEffect cleanup.
132	 */
133	export function startAuctionLifecycleTimer(): () => void {
134	  const tick = async () => {
135	    const now = Date.now()
136	    const toClose = await db.auctions
137	      .where('status')
138	      .anyOf('Active', 'Extended')
139	      .filter((a) => a.endTime <= now)
140	      .toArray()
141	
142	    for (const auction of toClose) {
143	      // Atomic guard: only process if we successfully transition to Ended
144	      const claimed = await db.transaction('rw', db.auctions, async () => {
145	        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
146	        if (!fresh || !['Active', 'Extended'].includes(fresh.status)) return false
147	        await db.auctions.update(auction.id, { status: 'Ended', updatedAt: Date.now() })
148	        return true
149	      })
150	
151	      if (claimed) {
152	        const fresh = await db.auctions.get(auction.id)
153	        if (fresh) await closeAuction(fresh)
154	      }
155	    }
156	  }
157	
158	  void tick()
159	  _timer = setInterval(() => {
160	    void tick()
161	  }, 15_000)
162	
163	  return () => {
164	    if (_timer !== null) {
165	      clearInterval(_timer)
166	      _timer = null
167	    }
168	  }
169	}

180	export async function prepareReservation(
181	  userId: string,
182	  auctionId: string,
183	  newReserveAmount: number,
184	  previousReserveAmount: number,
185	): Promise<PreparedReservation> {
186	  const wallet = await db.wallets.where('userId').equals(userId).first()
187	  if (!wallet) throw new Error('Wallet not found')
188	  const plain = await decryptWallet(wallet)
189	
190	  const delta = newReserveAmount - previousReserveAmount
191	  const available = plain.balance - plain.reservedAmount
192	  if (delta > 0 && available < delta)
193	    throw new Error('Insufficient wallet balance for deposit hold')
194	
195	  return {
196	    walletId: wallet.id,
197	    encReservedAmount: await encNum(plain.reservedAmount + delta),
198	    delta,
199	    auctionId,
200	    userId,
201	  }
202	}
